name: Dusty Rose Prism (Ioun Stone)
body:
Aura strong varied; CL 12th; Slot —; Price 5,000 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

This stone grants the wearer a +1 insight bonus to AC.

Cracked: This stone grants a +1 competence bonus on initiative checks. Price: 500 gp.

Flawed: This stone grants a +1 insight bonus to AC and a –2 penalty to Strength. Price: 4,000 gp.

See Inferior Ioun Stones for details on cracked and flawed variant stones.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Special creator must be 12th level; Cost 2,500 gp.
